title: Change of voice domain preference for E-UTRAN

entities.name: Change of voice domain preference for E-UTRAN
entities.description: Procedure executed by the UE when the voice domain preference for E-UTRAN changes, involving mode transitions and capability management.

entities.name: PS mode 1
entities.description: UE operating mode for packet-switched services only.

entities.name: PS mode 2
entities.description: UE operating mode for packet-switched services only.

entities.name: CS/PS mode 1
entities.description: UE operating mode supporting both circuit-switched and packet-switched services.

entities.name: CS/PS mode 2
entities.description: UE operating mode supporting both circuit-switched and packet-switched services.

entities.name: Combined tracking area update with IMSI attach
entities.description: Procedure combining tracking area update and IMSI attach for UE registration.

entities.name: Detach for non-EPS services
entities.description: Procedure to detach from non-EPS services when transitioning to IMS PS voice only.

entities.name: Disable E-UTRA capability
entities.description: Action to disable E-UTRA capability when transitioning to CS voice only under specific conditions.

entities.name: Re-enable E-UTRA capability
entities.description: Action to re-enable E-UTRA capability when transitioning from CS voice only, delayed if RR/RRC connection exists.

entities.name: CS fallback not available
entities.description: Condition where CS fallback is not available, including EMM causes #16, #17, and #18.

entities.name: CS fallback not preferred
entities.description: Condition where CS fallback is not preferred, indicated during combined attach or TAU.

entities.name: SMS only
entities.description: Condition where only SMS services are indicated during combined attach or TAU.

entities.name: RR or RRC connection exists
entities.description: Condition where an RR or RRC connection is active, delaying E-UTRA capability re-enablement.

relations.description: Change from IMS PS voice only to CS voice preferences requires combined TAU with IMSI attach.
Change to IMS PS voice only may require detach for non-EPS services.
Change to CS voice only under CSFB not available or not preferred conditions requires disabling E-UTRA capability.
Change from CS voice only to any configuration requires re-enabling E-UTRA capability.
Re-enabling E-UTRA capability is delayed if an RR or RRC connection exists.
Disabling E-UTRA capability is triggered when CS fallback is not available.
Disabling E-UTRA capability is triggered when CS fallback is not preferred.
Disabling E-UTRA capability is triggered when SMS only indication is received.
Procedure execution depends on UE operating in PS mode 1.
Procedure execution depends on UE operating in PS mode 2.
Procedure execution depends on UE operating in CS/PS mode 1.
Procedure execution depends on UE operating in CS/PS mode 2.
